# Vivek Indlebele Narasimha Prasad

Vivek is a founder, CTO, and product engineer.

## Current work

- Founder and CTO of GameStock, a fantasy stock and crypto tournament platform.
- Founder and CTO of Zen Shuttles, a campus ride-pooling startup that reached break-even within 15 months.
- Creator and maintainer of native React Native and Expo packages with 16K+ cumulative npm downloads.
